pr_title: WIP: drivers: peci: Set a minimum timeout for PECI commands with no payload
pr_body:
Fixes #27506
Set a minimum timeout for PECI commands with no payload

Signed-off-by: Jose Alberto Meza <jose.a.meza.arellano@intel.com>

issue_context.title: driver: peci: mchp: Ping command is failing due to improper tx wait timeout.
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
When ping command is sent driver which has zero data lenth, as the tx timeout is calculated in multiples of Tx data length, driver is not waiting for tx to complete.
Need to fix this.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. send peci_ping() command to driver.


**Expected behavior**
ping command should tx success.

**Impact**
peci app will fail for ping.

review_comments:
with current code(master), wait_timeout never decrements. hence the loop is waiting infinity for  (!(base->STATUS1 & MCHP_PECI_STS1_EOF)) to becode true.
With this fix, the timeout is bounded hence i observed that most of the commands are failing due to insufficient wait time.
Is this fix tested for ping and other peci commands?
@VenkatKotakonda Thanks for checking out this, will close this until I have HW access to debug further since it seems this is not a timeout problem.
